import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MO = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXM = 1000005;
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAXM];
    static int P, K;

    static int qpow(int x, int n) {
        long ans = 1;
        long base = x;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * base) % MO;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MO;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        P = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        if (K == 0) {
            System.out.println(qpow(P, P - 1));
            return;
        }
        if (K == 1) {
            System.out.println(qpow(P, P));
            return;
        }

        int p = 1;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
            if (vis[p]) break;
            cnt++;
            vis[p] = true;
            p = (int)((long)K * p % P);
        }
        System.out.println(qpow(P, P / cnt));
    }
}
